core_obligations: Reduce to alpha = [W] for an integral closed W of delta-dimension k and split into the two cases W contained in D and W not contained in D (proof lines 5892-5895).

Settle the case W contained in D: write i^*[W] = c_1(L_1) cap [W] + c_1(L_2) cap [W] by definition of the Gysin homomorphism and additivity, compute i_1^* p^*[W] through the decomposition p^{-1}(W) = W_1 union W_2 with W_i integral of dimension k + 1, and evaluate the chain of equalities down to p_1^*(c_1(L_1) cap [W]) + [W_1 intersect W_2]_k, using compatibility of c_1 with flat pullback (proof lines 5896-5925).

Identify [W_1 intersect W_2]_k with p_1^*(c_1(L_2) cap [W]) using that W_1 intersect W_2 is the zero section of the line bundle W_1 -> W and the line bundle formulae, so that the two sides agree; in the case W not contained in D observe that both sides are represented by the cycle associated to the scheme theoretic inverse image of W in D_1 (proof lines 5926-5937).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to one integral class and split on whether it lies in D (proof lines 5892-5895).
In the contained case compute both sides through the decomposition of p^{-1}(W) and the compatibility of c_1 with flat pullback (proof lines 5896-5925).
Identify the intersection with the pullback of c_1(L_2) cap [W], and handle the non-contained case by the same representing cycle (proof lines 5926-5937).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the compatibility i_1^* p^* alpha = p_1^* i^* alpha in CH_k(D_1) for all alpha in CH_k(Y), in the situation of the previous decomposition of the zero scheme of a section of a tensor product of invertible sheaves (statement lines 5883-5890, tag 0F98). The proof reduces to a single integral class and works out both sides explicitly when that class is contained in D: it writes the Gysin pullback by additivity, decomposes the flat pullback of the class through the two line bundles over it, moves c_1 across the flat pullback, and identifies the intersection of the two line bundles with the pullback of the second Chern class using the zero-section formula. The bookkeeping of that chain plus the trivial case is the substance, so the claim is H2.
